description: Paved roads as a Percentage of total roads in Kenya is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). Paved roads as a percentage of total roads in Kenya as reported by the Commission of Revenue Allocation in Kenya in 2011. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). Its tags are logistics, roads, transportation. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
